company.name: Loggi
company.shortDescription: Loggi is logistics company which uses technology to connect Brazil.
company.description:
Loggi is connecting Brazil, using technology to reinvent logistics with a fast, cost-efficient, and reliable network. It serves major e-commerce players, SMBs and individuals on their shipping needs. Loggi is unlocking the growth of the on-demand economy, supporting new commerce for Brazil’s large, young, urban population.

The company was founded in 2013 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
